data.jobspec:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --account=VeloC
#SBATCH --nodes=8
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --partition=full-node
#SBATCH --constraint=home
#SBATCH --mail-user=thomas.bouvier@inria.fr
#SBATCH --mail-type=ALL
#SBATCH --ntasks=64
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=8

# The Cobalt '--mode script' directive is the default behavior in Slurm and requires no translation.
# The mpiexec option '-map-by slot' was omitted. Slurm's default process mapping will be used.
# This may have performance implications. Consider adding a '--distribution' or '--cpu-bind' flag to
# srun if specific process placement is required.

set -eu

# note: disable registration cache for verbs provider for now; see
#       discussion in https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/5244
export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0
# use shared recv context in RXM; should improve scalability
export FI_OFI_RXM_USE_SRX=1

echo "Setting up spack"
source ${HOME}/git/spack-thetagpu/share/spack/setup-env.sh
echo "Activating env"
spack env activate /home/tbouvier/git/spack-envs/thetagpu

export WANDB_MODE=offline
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib64;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/lib;/lus/theta-fs0/software/thetagpu/openmpi/openmpi-4.1.4_ucx-1.14.0_gcc-9.4.0_cuda-11.4/lib;/usr/local/cuda-11/lib64"

# Export variables that were passed via 'mpiexec -x'
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO

# Jobs are run from the xps/thetagpu dir, main.py is at location ../..
# The -np, -npernode, and -hostfile arguments from mpiexec are now handled by #SBATCH directives and srun.
srun --cpu-bind=none python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config baseline_scratch_ghostnet_scale --log-level info

issues: The LD_LIBRARY_PATH variable is set using semicolons (';') as separators. The correct separator for a path list in Linux is a colon (':'). This will likely cause dynamic libraries to not be found.

The execution path `../../main.py` is relative to the submission directory. This can be fragile. It is recommended to use absolute paths or paths relative to the script's location for better portability.

The `srun` command uses `--cpu-bind=none`, which disables process affinity. As noted in the script's own comments, this may lead to suboptimal performance. Consider specifying a binding strategy if performance is critical.

#!/bin/zsh
#COBALT -A VeloC
#COBALT -n 8
#COBALT -t 2:00:00
#COBALT --mode script
#COBALT -q full-node
#COBALT --attr filesystems=home
#COBALT -M thomas.bouvier@inria.fr

set -eu

# note: disable registration cache for verbs provider for now; see
#       discussion in https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/5244
export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0
# use shared recv context in RXM; should improve scalability
export FI_OFI_RXM_USE_SRX=1

echo "Setting up spack"
source ${HOME}/git/spack-thetagpu/share/spack/setup-env.sh
echo "Activating env"
spack env activate /home/tbouvier/git/spack-envs/thetagpu

export WANDB_MODE=offline
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib64;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/lib;/lus/theta-fs0/software/thetagpu/openmpi/openmpi-4.1.4_ucx-1.14.0_gcc-9.4.0_cuda-11.4/lib;/usr/local/cuda-11/lib64"

# Jobs are run from the xps/thetagpu dir, main.py is at location ../..
mpiexec -np 64 -npernode 8 -hostfile $COBALT_NODEFILE -bind-to none -map-by slot -x NCCL_DEBUG=INFO -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH -x WANDB_MODE -x PATH python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config baseline_scratch_ghostnet_scale --log-level info
